chunks: And in it that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, did not grant Satan authority over the believers.
ai.seo_question: Does Satan have authority over believers?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this saying to affirm the Shia doctrine of *'Ismah* (infallibility) and divine protection for the faithful, distinguishing them from those who succumb to Satan's whispers. This statement underscores that while Satan may tempt, he lacks absolute authority (*sulṭān*) over believers who maintain their spiritual vigilance, a concept central to understanding the nature of free will in Shia theology.
